verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents automatic product reviews on pull requests once a repository is connected. Results appear as a GitHub check and summary with a 5-point score and P0/P1/P2 findings, can be re-run via push or `@foreloop retest`, and can optionally gate merges with a failure threshold. However, the evidence describes check/summary output rather than inline code comments, and never explicitly says the reviews are AI-generated. missing for 10: documented inline line-level review comments, explicit confirmation that reviews are AI-generated, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments

citations.quote: Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.
The GitHub check and summary show a score out of 5 with actionable P0, P1, and P2 findings.
Push changes or have a repository writer comment @foreloop retest.
Checks are advisory by default; an organization owner or admin can opt into a failure threshold.
